title: Storm Witch Over the City
description: A translucent, glowing female spirit with flowing white hair and robes rises above a stormy medieval harbor town, her form surrounded by a swirling vortex of wind, leaves, and debris. Below, townspeople with lanterns flee through the rain-swept streets as a wooden tower stands in the chaotic waters, while dark storm clouds with lightning swirl overhead in a dramatic vortex.
prompt: A translucent glowing female spirit with long flowing white hair and robes rises dramatically above a stormy medieval harbor town at night, her form creating a massive swirling vortex of wind, leaves, and debris that pulls in flying objects and birds. Townspeople with lanterns run in fear through rain-swept cobblestone streets as a tall wooden tower stands in the turbulent waters below, under a sky filled with dark purple storm clouds, lightning, and a massive swirling vortex, dramatic fantasy scene
